Summary: This commit updates LICM's MemorySSA-based hoist-safety check so dominated accesses are skipped when the instruction is not being sunk. The intent is to avoid treating already-dominated MemorySSA accesses as conflicting reads/writes during hoisting decisions, and it adds tests around inaccessible-memory calls and loop aliasing.
